title: Visited variables become deterministic
statement: Let a finite-domain constraint satisfaction problem have a nonempty multiset of constraints, with every declared variable occurring in some constraint scope. Suppose the domain is nonempty and the variable set has decidable equality. After running the local conditional steps through a list of variables from any initial state, each variable in that list has a law concentrated at the label assigned to it by the resulting state.
hypotheses_covered: The domain is finite and nonempty
The variable set has decidable equality
Every declared variable occurs in a constraint scope
A list of variables and an initial state
The specified variable belongs to the list
